high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "wehavethedata." The post was made 20 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. It features a tweet by Alec Stapp (@AlecStapp) with a question about French law regarding the floor area threshold at which a licensed architect is required to establish plans for a new home. The tweet includes a histogram titled "Distribution of floor area in new units, 2010." The x-axis represents the floor area in square meters, ranging from 40 to 390 square meters, while the y-axis represents the proportion (%)
